title: Reduce the leading local-error coefficient using a physical first-rung control
statement: For H=H_g+delta V+epsilon W,W=n_A0-n_B0,the leading joint small-error coefficient followed by g->0 is g^8(delta,epsilon) M (delta,epsilon)^T. M is the positive Gram integral of the COHERENT corrected shell amplitudes,approximately[[.0722287299931,.0764655091748],[.0764655091748,.0818535681928]]. Its minimizer epsilon=-.934174414911 delta leaves .000796607698822 delta^2 g^8,about a90.67 reduction in this leading coefficient.
